 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 W.P.No.29047 of 2010
Order:

This writ petition is filed with the following prayer:
" to issue any writ or order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of mandamus declaring the endorsement issued by the 3rd respondent and not paying the compensation to the petitioners' houses and house sites on par with private houses by acquiring the houses and house sites as per the provisions of Land Acquisition Act as illegal and arbitrary and consequently direct the respondents to acquire the house sites and structures in Sy.No.473 of Chinna Dagada Village under the provisions of Land Acquisition Act and pay the market value on par with private lands taking into consideration the order passed in O.P.No.107 of 2008 and batch on the file of the Senior Civil Judge, Wanaparthy."

2. Learned Counsel for the petitioners submits that the land in Sy.No.473 of Chinna Dagada was assigned as house sites to the petitioners and they have constructed houses in their respective house plots with their own money.

Pursuant to the notification issued by the respondent No.2 for acquisition of houses and some open area for the purpose of excavation of left main canal, the respondents have acquired the house SK,J sites of the petitioners.
The respondent No.3 passed the award dated 24.09.2003 fixing the market value at Rs.15/- per sq. meter both in the plinth area consisting of structures and also open area.

3. Learned Counsel for the petitioner further submits that as the notification was issued in respect of the private lands and the structure value for the houses situated in Sy.No.473 and for the houses situated in private land is one and the same, the land owners filed application.
Then the matter was referred to the Civil Court, which in turn fixed the market value one time addition to the structure value fixed by the respondent No.3.
Thereafter, the petitioners made a representation dated 07.03.2010 to the respondent Nos.2 and 3 for payment of market value fixed by the Civil Court, but no action has been taken.
Hence, the petitioners filed W.P.No.1760 of 2010 and the same was disposed of directing the respondent Nos.2 and 3 to consider the said representation.
As there was no SK,J action, the petitioners filed C.C.No.1282 of 2010, at that stage, the respondent No.3 rejected the claims of the petitioners vide endorsement dated 04.09.2010.

sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the petitioner further submits that though the market value is equal to the value assessed to the private land, the respondents are not paying compensation on par with the private lands.

He relied on the judgment of a larger Bench Judgment of this Court in Land Acquisition Officer- cum-Revenue Divisional Officer vs. Mekala Pandu 1 and submits that the petitioners are entitled for compensation on par with the private lands.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Officer- cum-Revenue Divisional Officer vs. Mekala Pandu 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. Having considered the submissions made and perusal of the record, this Court is of the considered view that admittedly the Civil Court fixed the market value for the acquired houses/structures of the private lands in the village one time in addition to the 1 2004(2) ALT 546 SK,J structure value fixed by the respondent No.3 vide Judgment dated 29.12.2008 in O.P.No.107 of 2008 and batch.
6.

In view of the Judgment of the larger Bench of this Court in Mekala Pandu's case (cited supra),
the petitioners are entitled compensation on par with the private lands in the village for the same purpose 7.

In view of the same, the Writ Petition is allowed by setting aside the impugned endorsement dated 04.09.2010 and the respondent No.3 is directed to re-determine the compensation and pay the same to the petitioners as per Section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 on par with the private lands of the same notification as per the judgment and decree dated 29.12.2008 in O.P.No.107 of 2008 and batch on the file of the Senior Civil Judge at Wanaparthy within a period of three (3) months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
No order as to costs.
SK,J 8.
Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending in this writ petition, shall stand closed.
JUSTICE K.SARATH Date:11.01.2024
